title: Ability to turn off grouping in history, for true chronological view
line: Notification history can now be shown as one chronological list instead of grouped by application, with a new option in Notifications settings.
explanation: The notifications applet hard-coded GroupApplicationsFlat for its history model, so notifications were always bundled per application and the newest one could sit below older groups; since 129134c752 only the order inside each group follows the date. There was no way to get a plain chronological list. The change adds a GroupHistoryByApplication setting (default on, so nothing changes for existing users) with a "Group notifications by application" checkbox in a new History section of the Notifications KCM; when it is off the applet uses GroupDisabled, giving a newest-first flat list with a separator between every item, and libnotificationmanager now also drops the group-collapsing proxy when grouping is turned off so it can be switched back at runtime.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: add an option to not group the history by app

The notification history always grouped notifications by application,
so the newest one could be buried under older groups. A new "Group
notifications by application" setting can now turn it into a plain list.

BUG: 454070

patches.diff:
From 3cfd10ca9f252f8f39da87b88bea6fa3f58d97c2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 00:04:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: add an option to not group the history
 by app

The notification history always grouped notifications by application,
so the newest one could be buried under older groups. A new "Group
notifications by application" setting can now turn it into a plain list.

BUG: 454070
---
 applets/notifications/FullRepresentation.qml    |  2 +-
 applets/notifications/main.qml                  |  3 ++-
 kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml                  | 17 +++++++++++++++++
 .../kcfg/notificationsettings.kcfg              |  3 +++
 libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp        |  1 +
 libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp             | 14 ++++++++++++++
 libnotificationmanager/settings.h               |  9 +++++++++
 7 files changed, 47 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/notifications/FullRepresentation.qml b/applets/notifications/FullRepresentation.qml
index ce873eca4d..7697377d3e 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/FullRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/FullRepresentation.qml
@@ -343,7 +343,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
             }
 
             section {
-                property: "desktopEntry"
+                property: fullRepresentationRoot.historyModel.groupMode === NotificationManager.Notifications.GroupDisabled ? "notificationId" : "desktopEntry"
                 criteria: ViewSection.FullString
                 delegate: Item {
                     width: list.width
diff --git a/applets/notifications/main.qml b/applets/notifications/main.qml
index 8d98753eca..5d990f518d 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/main.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/main.qml
@@ -177,7 +177,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         showDismissed: true
         showJobs: notificationSettings.jobsInNotifications
         sortMode: NotificationManager.Notifications.SortByDate
-        groupMode: NotificationManager.Notifications.GroupApplicationsFlat
+        groupMode: notificationSettings.groupHistoryByApplication ? NotificationManager.Notifications.GroupApplicationsFlat
+                                                                  : NotificationManager.Notifications.GroupDisabled
         groupLimit: 2
         expandUnread: true
         ignoreBlacklistDuringInhibition: true
diff --git a/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml b/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml
index 83dc77275c..9bdec8da8d 100644
--- a/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml
+++ b/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml
@@ -314,6 +314,23 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             }
         }
 
+        Item {
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@title:group", "History")
+            Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
+        }
+
+        QtControls.CheckBox {
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Group notifications by application")
+            checked: kcm.notificationSettings.groupHistoryByApplication
+            onClicked: kcm.notificationSettings.groupHistoryByApplication = checked
+
+            KCM.SettingStateBinding {
+                configObject: kcm.notificationSettings
+                settingName: "GroupHistoryByApplication"
+                extraEnabledConditions: root.notificationsAvailable
+            }
+        }
+
         Item {
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@title:group", "Additional feedback")
             Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/notificationsettings.kcfg b/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/notificationsettings.kcfg
index 2d5ef9081e..5a705ccb98 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/notificationsettings.kcfg
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/notificationsettings.kcfg
@@ -33,6 +33,9 @@
         <entry name="ShowPopupTimeout" type="Bool">
             <default>true</default>
         </entry>
+        <entry name="GroupHistoryByApplication" type="Bool">
+            <default>true</default>
+        </entry>
     </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp b/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp
index baa61cecc9..0e389404ae 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp
@@ -279,6 +279,7 @@ void Notifications::Private::initProxyModels()
         sortModel->setSourceModel(filterModel);
         limiterModel->setSourceModel(sortModel);
         delete std::exchange(flattenModel, nullptr);
+        delete std::exchange(groupCollapsingModel, nullptr);
         delete std::exchange(groupingModel, nullptr);
     }
 
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp b/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp
index 9e0da288ab..95776eeb29 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp
@@ -442,6 +442,20 @@ void Settings::setShowPopupTimeout(bool show)
     d->setDirty(true);
 }
 
+bool Settings::groupHistoryByApplication() const
+{
+    return d->notificationSettings.groupHistoryByApplication();
+}
+
+void Settings::setGroupHistoryByApplication(bool group)
+{
+    if (this->groupHistoryByApplication() == group) {
+        return;
+    }
+    d->notificationSettings.setGroupHistoryByApplication(group);
+    d->setDirty(true);
+}
+
 bool Settings::jobsInNotifications() const
 {
     return d->jobSettings.inNotifications();
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/settings.h b/libnotificationmanager/settings.h
index 82eb89d055..1c0216ef9a 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/settings.h
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/settings.h
@@ -67,6 +67,12 @@ class NOTIFICATIONMANAGER_EXPORT Settings : public QObject
      */
     Q_PROPERTY(bool showPopupTimeout READ showPopupTimeout WRITE setShowPopupTimeout NOTIFY settingsChanged)
 
+    /**
+     * Whether notifications in the history are grouped by application.
+     * When disabled, the history is a plain chronological list.
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(bool groupHistoryByApplication READ groupHistoryByApplication WRITE setGroupHistoryByApplication NOTIFY settingsChanged)
+
     /**
      * Whether to show application jobs as notifications
      */
@@ -287,6 +293,9 @@ public:
     bool showPopupTimeout() const;
     void setShowPopupTimeout(bool show);
 
+    bool groupHistoryByApplication() const;
+    void setGroupHistoryByApplication(bool group);
+
     bool jobsInNotifications() const;
     void setJobsInNotifications(bool enable);
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: notifications 1-6 from Konsole, Dolphin and Kate arrive interleaved, but the history shows them grouped (6, 3 | 5, 2 | 4 …), so it isn't chronological.
Grouping turned off: the same six notifications are listed newest first, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 …
Master Notifications settings: no option about grouping.
New History section with "Group notifications by application" (on by default), here unchecked and applied.
